cfgFormat.summary: cfg is a URL query param holding EITHER (a) the shortcode 'folia-theme://' + base64(UTF-8 JSON) whose JSON MUST use the minified short keys, OR (b) a plain JSON string (no prefix) that may use EITHER the minified short keys OR the long store key names. Long names are accepted as plain JSON, e.g. cfg={"visualizerMode":"sonnet","visualizerTunings":{"sonnet":{...full object...}}}. Inside visualizerTunings (short key 'vt') the per-mode objects ALWAYS use long field names in both forms - vt is stored/decoded verbatim, never minified. Tunings are NOT merged with defaults on the OBS path: always send the complete per-mode object (start from the 'defaults' given for each mode).
decodePath: ObsNowPlayingSourceApp.tsx:19 -> obsWebAppearance.ts:104 buildObsAppearanceFromShortcode -> :110 decompressConfig(cfg); any throw is swallowed at :111 and the overlay silently falls back to defaults + cover-color theme.
src/utils/appearanceCodec.ts:573 decompressConfig: trims; :576-582 if it starts with 'folia-theme://' -> atob(base64) -> TextDecoder UTF-8 -> JSON.parse; else :584 JSON.parse(raw).

appearanceCodec.ts:591-622 isMinified = shortcode-prefixed OR any of these short keys present: t, vm, rvms, ccb, dvgb, dvv, stm, soo, ct, cat, dot, nbt, lbt, hpts, sst, sob, shs, hsb, lfw, sfw, lff, sfi, pdt, snt, fst, stp, stpt, stph.

appearanceCodec.ts:623-689 minified branch: maps each short key to its long name (vt -> visualizerTunings verbatim at :661; mbt/nbt/lbt/sbt background tunings are run through decompress* which fill missing fields from DEFAULT_*). Unknown/long keys in this branch are dropped.

appearanceCodec.ts:690-711 long-key branch: requires at least one key from validKeys (:691-706) else throws 'Invalid visual settings configuration'; returns the parsed object AS-IS (no defaults filled, no validation, background tunings raw too).

obsWebAppearance.ts:116-120 mode = URL param visualizer (if a builtin id) > cfg.visualizerMode > 'classic'; :160 visualizerTunings: decoded.visualizerTunings passed straight to <VisualizerRenderer> (ObsWebSourceApp.tsx:230).

src/components/visualizer/VisualizerRenderer.tsx:17 -> tuningRegistry.ts:72-73 applyVisualizerTuning takes bundle[mode] and the mode's tuning.ts adapter just spreads it into props (<mode>Tuning: tuning) - no merge with defaults.
cfgFormat.recommendation: Simplest robust choice for a wrapper: send plain long-key JSON (percent-encoded) and always include full objects for visualizerTunings[mode] and for any background tuning. If you prefer the shortcode, build it exactly like compressConfig (appearanceCodec.ts:496-568): minify top-level keys, keep vt verbatim, minify background tunings field-by-field, then 'folia-theme://' + btoa(UTF-8 bytes). Either way percent-encode the value (encodeURIComponent / URLSearchParams): a raw '+' in base64 becomes a space and corrupts the payload.
gotchas: Raw JSON using ONLY short keys that are not in the isMinified detector list (vt, vo, bo, vbm, lfn, lfs, lcf, sulb, sfsz, sfs, sff, sfff, scm, mbt, sbt, ...) is misdetected as long-key JSON, fails validKeys and throws -> silent defaults. Prefix with folia-theme:// or include a detector key (e.g. vm).
Mixing forms does not work: in the minified branch long keys are dropped; in the long branch short keys are ignored.
Long-key branch: lyricsCustomFontFamily is not in validKeys (:691-706) but is still passed through as long as some other valid key is present.
Per-mode legacy keys (classicTuning/ct, cadenzaTuning/cat, ..., lumiereTuning/lmt) are decoded but IGNORED by the OBS page - only visualizerTunings[mode] is used (obsWebAppearance.ts:160).
Only the active mode's entry in visualizerTunings matters; others are ignored.

notes: Built against chthollyphile/folia-major @ 43e7846. Labels are zh-CN (Simplified) from src/i18n/locales/zh-CN.ts; every referenced i18n key exists, so no field is labelMissing except cadenza's (no settings panel at all).

Cadenza (心象, labelKey ui.visualizerCadenze - note the typo in the key) has a tuning type and defaults but NO settings panel, so its fields have no labels/ranges; beamIntensity is forced to 0 by the store.

Non-cfg URL params of the now-playing page (obsWebAppearance.ts parseObsWebParams): obs=1&obsSource=now-playing, host=<host:port>, daylight=1 (light theme side; default dark), transparent=1 (else opaque theme background), visualizer=<mode id> (overrides cfg.visualizerMode), obsTheme=static|builtin|ai (static uses cfg.theme; builtin/ai ignore cfg.theme and derive per song). Keep cfg as the last param.

Theme colors ride in cfg.theme ({light, dark} Theme objects: name, backgroundColor, primaryColor, accentColor, secondaryColor, fontStyle, fontFamily, animationIntensity calm|normal|chaotic, wordColors, lyricsIcons, description) and are only used with obsTheme=static (or no obsTheme marker). Not inventoried as fields here.

Skipped (need uploads / files / URLs): Cappella custom emoji pack + custom avatars (emojiPackSource/avatarSource 'custom'), Monet custom portrait (portraitSource 'custom'), Monet/Nomand uploaded background (backgroundSource/imageSource 'uploaded-global'), Tempera layerImages pool (+ layerImageDepth/Frequency), URL/embed background (visualizerBackgroundMode 'url' + urlBackgroundList/urlBackgroundSelectedId), uploaded custom lyric fonts. Options that need an upload are flagged requiresUpload:true. On the web OBS page uploaded images can only arrive via the OBS source's Custom CSS assets (ObsWebSourceApp readObsCustomCssAssets: background, portrait, cappella emojis/avatars); Tempera layer images only reach the local Electron OBS browser source, never the web cfg.

Main-app-only / no effect on the OBS now-playing page: latentBackgroundTuning.dynamicOnlyInPlayer (depends on main-window currentView), monet showPortraitDragHanger/portraitOffsetX dragging (no onMonetTuningChange in OBS; the hanger still renders), randomVisualizerModePerSong, foliumParams (mods are not loaded in OBS), song-theme automation flags, followSystemTheme, stageTrackPill*.

lyricsFontScale is ignored by sonnet and tempera (auto-sized; zh-CN sonnetFontSizeAutoNotice/temperaFontSizeAutoNotice) and only affects subtitles in lumiere; it multiplies cadenza and monet fontScale.

The four 'common background' controls (disableVisualizerVignette, disableVisualizerGeometricBackground, useCoverColorBg, backgroundOpacity) are only shown when visualizerBackgroundMode is 'common'; backgroundOpacity only takes effect while useCoverColorBg is true. disableVisualizerGeometricBackground also suppresses fume's own geometric layer in any background mode.

Diorama geometryVisibility is a nested object; its fields are listed with dotted keys ('geometryVisibility.mode' etc.). Several Diorama/background sliders are disabled rather than hidden by a parent toggle (noted per field); showWhen is only set where the panel actually hides the control.
Boolean fields carry an 'options' array when the panel renders them as labelled two-choice chips (e.g. 显示/隐藏); fume hidePrintSymbols/disableGeometricBackground are inverted flags (true = hidden).

Extra per-field properties: labelKey (i18n key), presets (quick-pick chips), unit, integer, nullable (null = auto), array (string[]), nested, derived, mainAppOnly, noPanel. Each mode/background also has a 'defaults' object = the exact DEFAULT_*_TUNING from src/types.ts, suitable as the base for a full object.

visualizerMode option order follows registry 'order' (sonnet 10, tempera 20, lumiere 25, classic 30, cadenza 40, partita 50, fume 60, tilt 70, claddagh 80, monet 90, pendolo 100, cappella 110, diorama 120, still 130).
